notes.title: 24.04.19. Update (v1.21)
notes.content:
Hello! In this update, we made the following changes:

[h3]1. Intro story skip feature added.[/h3]
If you watch the intro story once, from the next time on a button to skip the intro and start the game immediately will be activated.

[h3]2. Modified some of the story text displayed when starting the game.[/h3]
The previous text was "restore the lost emotions,” but since the game’s objective is to recover all emotions it could be confusing. We have updated it to “restore all the lost emotions.”

[h3]3. Library icon and client icon changed.[/h3]
The library icon has been redesigned to be more visible even at small sizes.
The client icon has been changed to a more fun design with higher?resolution images.

notes.title: 2025.04.14. Update Notes (v1.2)
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you for purchasing and playing our game! In this update, we've made a few patches to make the gameplay more enjoyable. Please feel free to leave us your feedback!

[h3]1. A cute mouse cursor has been added. [/h3]
It’s really adorable. Check it out in the game. 😊

[h3]2. Achievements have been added. (Finally!)[/h3]
There are two achievements in total:

1) An achievement for reaching the final stage block and recovering all emotions
2) An achievement for clearing the hidden ending

For the second achievement, if you’ve previously achieved it, it will automatically unlock when you access the game on the same PC.
Unfortunately, the first achievement won’t be unlocked automatically, even if you’ve achieved it before (we didn’t store the record... 😥 But we believe skilled players like you can definitely achieve it again!)
We hope the addition of achievements makes your gameplay experience even more fun!

[h3]3. Fixed a bug where effects would not disappear when restarting the game during effect playback.[/h3]

The logo on the title screen has been changed.
We improved visibility and made the game title clearer to recognize.

[u]Spoiler Alert![/u]
The following content contains game spoilers, so we recommend reading it only if you’ve reached the mission related to the hidden ending.

[spoiler]
[h3]5. A UI has been added to indicate the objective of the mission to cover the watermelon’s lid.[/h3]
Some players were unsure of what to do since there was no explanation. So we added a UI to clearly show the mission's objective.

[h3]6. The watermelon’s expression has been changed during the lid-covering mission.[/h3]
Despite the urgency of the mission, the watermelon still had heart eyes, which felt unnatural. Now, when the mission starts, the watermelon’s face changes to a surprised expression to better match the tense atmosphere.
[/spoiler]

notes.title: 25.04.10. Update (v1.11)
notes.content:
Hello! This update includes improvements for a better gameplay experience and bug fixes.

[b]Spoiler Alert![/b]
This patch content may contain spoilers, so we recommend only players who have created the final stage block read this.

[spoiler]
[h3]1. Fixed an issue where the button to return to the main screen after clearing the hidden ending did not display correctly at certain resolutions.[/h3]

[h3]2. When the final stage block (Love) is crafted, all stage 1 blocks (Anxiety) will disappear. If a stage 1 block was announced as the next block, it will also be replaced with another block.[/h3]
In the previous version, we made it so that stage 1 blocks would no longer appear after crafting the final stage block. However, stage 1 blocks that were already generated or announced remained. We assumed players would discard the remaining stage 1 block and continue playing, but this was my mistake. Players didn't know that stage 1 blocks would no longer appear, so they often kept holding onto the stage 1 block, which became a major obstacle to reaching the ending. While maintaining the original update's design direction, an additional patch has been implemented to fundamentally prevent this problematic situation from occurring.
[/spoiler]

notes.title: April 1, 2025 Update - v1.1
notes.content:
English
Hello! Thank you for purchasing and playing our game. We have prepared an update with several changes to improve your gameplay experience.

Hello! Thank you for purchasing and playing our game. We have prepared an update with several changes to improve your gameplay experience. If you have any feedback about the game, please let us know in a review!
(Note! Since the final patch notes may contain spoilers, we recommend that only players who have crafted the final stage block read it.)

[h3] The rewards for crafting blocks at each stage are now more clearly communicated to the player. [/h3]
Previously, it was difficult for players to notice when rewards (life recovery) were given for crafting blocks at certain stages. We have implemented a patch that clearly notifies the player of this through a highly noticeable UI.
[list]
[*] A separate popup has been added to indicate which block was crafted and how much life was recovered as a reward.
[/list]

[h3] A cute effect has been added to the game intro sequence. [/h3]
[list]
[*] So cute..😊
[/list]

[b] Spoiler Warning! [/b]
[u] Since the final patch notes may contain spoilers, we recommend that only players who have crafted the final stage block read it. [/u]

[spoiler]
[h3] The difficulty of reaching the hidden ending has been slightly lowered. [/h3]
There was an issue where the process of reaching the hidden ending was overly dependent on luck. This could lead to frustration or loss of motivation during the attempt. With a few adjustments, we have rebalanced the difficulty to make the hidden ending more achievable, providing motivation and allowing more players to reach it.
[list]
[*] The reward for crafting the final stage block (Love) has been increased from +2 to +3.
[*] After crafting the final stage block (Love), the stage 1 block (Anxiety) will no longer appear. (If a stage 1 block was already previewed as the next block before crafting the final stage block, the previewed block will still appear.)
[/list]
[/spoiler]
